name: Martin Zumsande
cooked: It is a slow and not very reliable heuristic - we need multiple samples since connections could also fail because our addrman is old/of low quality. it would be ideal if we could detect this immediately and with a high degree of certainty during init but that doesn’t seem to be all that easy given that something like pinging hard-coded popular IPv6 addresses is probably out of the question for privacy reasons.
